concepts.def: Tiny air sacs in the lungs where gas exchange occurs.
Huge surface area, thin walls, moist lining, good blood supply — efficient diffusion.
Oxygen diffuses from alveoli into blood; CO₂ diffuses from blood into alveoli.
Mechanical movement of air into and out of the lungs by the ribs and diaphragm.
Diaphragm contracts and flattens, ribs rise; volume increases, pressure decreases, air rushes in.
Tubes carrying air from mouth to alveoli; lined with cilia and mucus to clean it.
